    def construct(self):
        # Cinematic configuration
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f0f1e"
        self.camera.frame.save_state()
        
        # Color palette
        C_SIGMOID = "#3498db"
        C_TANH = "#2ecc71"
        C_RELU = "#e74c3c"
        C_LEAKY = "#f39c12"
        C_TEXT = "#ecf0f1"
        C_ACCENT = "#9b59b6"
        
        # Helper for creating styled axes
        def styled_axes(x_range, y_range, height=4, width=6):
            return Axes(
                x_range=x_range,
                y_range=y_range,
                x_length=width,
                y_length=height,
                axis_config={
                    "color": "#7f8c8d",
                    "stroke_width": 2,
                    "include_tip": True,
                    "tip_config": {"fill_color": C_TEXT, "width": 0.15, "height": 0.15}
                },
                tips=True,
            ).set_opacity(0.9)
        
        # Title sequence with dramatic zoom
        title = Text("ACTIVATION FUNCTIONS", font="Montserrat", font_size=80, color=C_TEXT, weight=BOLD)
        subtitle = Text("Introducing Non-Linearity into Neural Networks", font="Montserrat", font_size=32, color="#95a5a6")
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle).center()
        
        self.play(Write(title, run_time=2), FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.5, run_time=2))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(
            title_group.animate.scale(0.45).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4).shift(LEFT*4),
            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        # Opening statement
        statement = Text(
            "Without activation functions, deep networks collapse into simple linear models...",
            font_size=28,
            color=C_TEXT,
            t2c={"activation functions": C_ACCENT, "linear": "#e74c3c"}
        )
        statement.next_to(title_group, DOWN, buff=0.8).shift(RIGHT*2)
        statement.set_width(10)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(statement, shift=UP*0.3, run_time=1.5))
        self.wait(1.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(statement))
        
        # SECTION 1: SIGMOID
        sigmoid_container = VGroup()
        
        sig_title = Text("Sigmoid", font="Montserrat", font_size=44, color=C_SIGMOID, weight=BOLD)
        sig_title.move_to(LEFT*4 + UP*2)
        
        sig_formula = MathTex(r"\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{1 + e^{-x}}", font_size=38, color=C_TEXT)
        sig_formula.next_to(sig_title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        sig_axes = styled_axes([-5, 5, 1], [-0.2, 1.2, 0.2], height=4.5, width=7)
        sig_axes.next_to(sig_formula, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        # Plot sigmoid
        sig_graph = sig_axes.plot(lambda x: 1/(1 + np.exp(-x)), x_range=[-5, 5], color=C_SIGMOID, stroke_width=5)
        sig_graph.set_stroke(opacity=0.9)
        
        # Asymptotes
        upper_asym = DashedLine(sig_axes.c2p(-5, 1), sig_axes.c2p(5, 1), color=C_SIGMOID, stroke_opacity=0.4, dash_length=0.15)
        lower_asym = DashedLine(sig_axes.c2p(-5, 0), sig_axes.c2p(5, 0), color=C_SIGMOID, stroke_opacity=0.4, dash_length=0.15)
        
        sigmoid_container.add(sig_title, sig_formula, sig_axes, upper_asym, lower_asym)
        
        self.play(
            Write(sig_title),
            Write(sig_formula),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(Create(sig_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(upper_asym), Create(lower_asym))
        self.play(Create(sig_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        # Characteristics
        chars = VGroup(
            Text("• Output range: (0, 1)", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Smooth, differentiable", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Vanishing gradient problem", font_size=24, color="#e74c3c"),
            Text("• Not zero-centered", font_size=24, color="#e67e22")
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
        chars.next_to(sig_axes, RIGHT, buff=1.2)
        chars.align_to(sig_axes, UP)
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(VGroup(sigmoid_container, chars).get_center()).set_width(VGroup(sigmoid_container, chars).width * 1.3),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c, shift=RIGHT*0.2) for c in chars], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # SECTION 2: TANH (Slide comparison)
        tanh_container = VGroup()
        
        tanh_title = Text("Tanh", font="Montserrat", font_size=44, color=C_TANH, weight=BOLD)
        tanh_title.move_to(RIGHT*4 + UP*2)
        
        tanh_formula = MathTex(r"\tanh(x) = \frac{e^x - e^{-x}}{e^x + e^{-x}}", font_size=38, color=C_TEXT)
        tanh_formula.next_to(tanh_title, DOWN, buff=0.4)
        
        tanh_axes = styled_axes([-5, 5, 1], [-1.2, 1.2, 0.5], height=4.5, width=7)
        tanh_axes.next_to(tanh_formula, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        
        tanh_graph = tanh_axes.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), x_range=[-5, 5], color=C_TANH, stroke_width=5)
        
        tanh_upper = DashedLine(tanh_axes.c2p(-5, 1), tanh_axes.c2p(5, 1), color=C_TANH, stroke_opacity=0.4, dash_length=0.15)
        tanh_lower = DashedLine(tanh_axes.c2p(-5, -1), tanh_axes.c2p(5, -1), color=C_TANH, stroke_opacity=0.4, dash_length=0.15)
        
        tanh_chars = VGroup(
            Text("• Output range: (-1, 1)", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Zero-centered", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Stronger gradients", font_size=24, color="#2ecc71"),
            Text("• Still vanishes at extremes", font_size=24, color="#e74c3c")
        ).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.3)
        tanh_chars.next_to(tanh_axes, RIGHT, buff=1.2)
        tanh_chars.align_to(tanh_axes, UP)
        
        tanh_container.add(tanh_title, tanh_formula, tanh_axes, tanh_upper, tanh_lower)
        
        # Pan camera to show comparison
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(RIGHT*3).set_width(18),
            run_time=2.5,
            rate_func=smooth
        )
        
        self.play(
            Write(tanh_title),
            Write(tanh_formula),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(Create(tanh_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(tanh_upper), Create(tanh_lower))
        self.play(Create(tanh_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(c, shift=RIGHT*0.2) for c in tanh_chars], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Transition to ReLU (clear screen)
        everything_old = VGroup(sigmoid_container, sig_graph, chars, tanh_container, tanh_graph, tanh_chars)
        
        relu_header = VGroup(
            Text("ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=56, color=C_RELU, weight=BOLD),
            Text("Rectified Linear Unit", font_size=32, color="#95a5a6")
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        relu_header.to_edge(UP, buff=1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeOut(everything_old),
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set_width(14),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # SECTION 3: RELU
        relu_formula = MathTex(r"f(x) = \max(0, x)", font_size=44, color=C_TEXT)
        relu_formula.next_to(relu_header, DOWN, buff=0.8)
        
        relu_axes = styled_axes([-5, 5, 1], [-1, 5, 1], height=6, width=10)
        relu_axes.center()
        relu_axes.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        # Create ReLU graph as path for dramatic draw
        relu_points = [relu_axes.c2p(-5, 0), relu_axes.c2p(0, 0), relu_axes.c2p(5, 5)]
        relu_graph = VMobject()
        relu_graph.set_points_as_corners(relu_points)
        relu_graph.set_stroke(color=C_RELU, width=6)
        
        # Glow effect
        relu_glow = relu_graph.copy().set_stroke(color=C_RELU, width=14, opacity=0.3)
        
        # Dead zone highlight
        dead_rect = Rectangle(
            width=relu_axes.x_length/2,
            height=relu_axes.y_length/6,
            fill_color=C_RELU,
            fill_opacity=0.15,
            stroke_width=0
        )
        dead_rect.move_to(relu_axes.c2p(-2.5, 0))
        dead_label = Text("\"Dying ReLU\" - Gradient = 0", font_size=26, color=C_RELU).next_to(dead_rect, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(
            Write(relu_header),
            run_time=1
        )
        self.play(Write(relu_formula), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(relu_glow), Create(relu_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(dead_rect), Write(dead_label), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # SECTION 4: LEAKY RELU (Split screen)
        leaky_header = VGroup(
            Text("Leaky ReLU", font="Montserrat", font_size=48, color=C_LEAKY, weight=BOLD),
            MathTex(r"\alpha = 0.1", font_size=32, color=C_LEAKY)
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)

        leaky_graph.set_stroke(color=C_LEAKY, width=6)

            run_time=2,
            rate_func=smooth
        )

            Write(leaky_header),
            Write(leaky_formula),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        self.play(Create(leaky_axes), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(leaky_glow), Create(leaky_graph), run_time=2.5, rate_func=smooth)
        
        # Comparison arrow
        fix_arrow = CurvedArrow(
            relu_axes.c2p(-2, 1),
            leaky_axes.c2p(-2, 1),
            color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=3,
            angle=-0.3
        )
        fix_text = Text("Small negative slope\nfixes dead neurons", font_size=24, color=C_LEAKY, line_spacing=1.2)
        fix_text.next_to(fix_arrow, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(fix_arrow), Write(fix_text), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # FINAL COMPARISON GRID
        self.play(
            FadeOut(relu_header), FadeOut(relu_formula), FadeOut(relu_axes), 
            FadeOut(relu_graph), FadeOut(relu_glow), FadeOut(dead_rect), FadeOut(dead_label),

            FadeOut(leaky_graph), FadeOut(leaky_glow), FadeOut(fix_arrow), FadeOut(fix_text),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        # Sigmoid mini

        s_graph = s_ax.plot(lambda x: 1/(1+np.exp(-x)), color=C_SIGMOID, stroke_width=4)
        s_label = Text("Sigmoid", font_size=28, color=C_SIGMOID, weight=BOLD).next_to(s_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        s_group = VGroup(s_ax, s_graph, s_label)
        
        # Tanh mini
        t_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-1, 1, 0.5], **mini_config)
        t_graph = t_ax.plot(lambda x: np.tanh(x), color=C_TANH, stroke_width=4)
        t_label = Text("Tanh", font_size=28, color=C_TANH, weight=BOLD).next_to(t_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        t_group = VGroup(t_ax, t_graph, t_label)
        
        # ReLU mini
        r_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-0.5, 3, 1], **mini_config)
        r_graph = VMobject()
        r_graph.set_points_as_corners([r_ax.c2p(-3, 0), r_ax.c2p(0, 0), r_ax.c2p(3, 3)])
        r_graph.set_stroke(color=C_RELU, width=4)
        r_label = Text("ReLU", font_size=28, color=C_RELU, weight=BOLD).next_to(r_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        r_group = VGroup(r_ax, r_graph, r_label)
        
        # Leaky mini
        l_ax = styled_axes([-3, 3, 1], [-0.5, 3, 1], **mini_config)
        l_graph = VMobject()
        l_graph.set_points_as_corners([l_ax.c2p(-3, -0.3), l_ax.c2p(0, 0), l_ax.c2p(3, 3)])
        l_graph.set_stroke(color=C_LEAKY, width=4)
        l_label = Text("Leaky ReLU", font_size=28, color=C_LEAKY, weight=BOLD).next_to(l_ax, UP, buff=0.2)
        l_group = VGroup(l_ax, l_graph, l_label)
        
        # Position grid
        top_row = VGroup(s_group, t_group).arrange(RIGHT, buff=2)
        bot_row = VGroup(r_group, l_group).arrange(RIGHT, buff=2)
        grid = VGroup(top_row, bot_row).arrange(DOWN, buff=1.5)
        grid.center()
        
        self.play(
            self.camera.frame.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).set_width(16),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                Create(s_group),
                Create(t_group),
                Create(r_group),
                Create(l_group),
                lag_ratio=0.2
            ),
            run_time=3
        )
        
        # Key insight
        insight = Text(
            "The choice of activation shapes how your network learns.",
            font_size=36,
            color=C_TEXT,
            weight=BOLD
        )
        insight.to_edge(DOWN, buff=1)
        
        self.play(Write(insight), run_time=2)
        self.wait(2)
        
        # Outro
        self.play(
            FadeOut(grid),
            FadeOut(insight),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        final = Text("Modern defaults: ReLU for hidden layers, Sigmoid/Softmax for output", 
                    font_size=38, color=C_TEXT, line_spacing=1.5)
        final.center()
        
        highlight = SurroundingRectangle(final, color=C_ACCENT, stroke_width=3, buff=0.3)
        
        self.play(Write(final), run_time=2.5)
        self.play(Create(highlight), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(final), FadeOut(highlight), FadeOut(title_group), run_time=2)
